measurement_limits: Each case owns a fresh worker process, schema and HTTP Moto; phases own fresh Pipeline instances.
Cold clears only the application file cache by using an absent directory; warm reuses it. OS, PostgreSQL and Moto caches remain warm after setup.
Wall/CPU includes instance construction and report/identity serialization; Python CPU excludes PostgreSQL and supervisor/Moto.
Process lifetime RSS includes setup and imports; endpoint RSS is not a phase peak. Session RSS is sampled, can miss peaks and is null if child discovery fails.
PostgreSQL/Moto/other host processes are excluded from worker RSS; whole VPS/process-tree peak memory remains unknown.
Owned disk is sampled files plus schema relations; excludes WAL, SQL temp files, server logs and Moto RAM. Upload admission caps cumulative encoded payload before each write.
Storage counters are History client logical requests/bytes, not provider bills; http_attempts includes retries. Partial in-flight phase usage can be unavailable after forced termination.
Prices are optional dated scenario arithmetic, separate from measured usage. No source, paid analysis or commerce activation is run.
Local synthetic planning evidence only; no target-VPS capacity certificate or production cost is established.
